User Profile

Welcome, {{ username }}!

Your comment: {{ comment }}

{% if username == 'admin' %}

Password Hint: {{ admin_password }}

{% endif %} ''' return render_template_string(template, username=username, comment=comment, admin_password=ADMIN_PASSWORD) ``` Wait, the instructions say "Preserve application behavior and unrelated code" and "Use the smallest correct fix".
